title: Absolutely worth the price! Rodrigo was amazing!
text: Rodrigo was AMAZING! He is extremely knowledgable, funny and courteous. I learned so much about the city of Barcelona as well as Antoni Gaudí and Sagrada Família! I highly recommend him for this or any tour in which he is the guide!

title: A masterclass in Barcelona’s history and architecture
text: Touring the Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Família, and Park Güell was high on our bucket list. And our guide Xavier made it a dream experience. He is an outstanding guide—super welcoming, incredibly insightful, and full of fascinating details about Gaudí and Barcelona's past. We learned so much and had a wonderful time from start to finish.  The team at Explore Catalina was fantastic too!!
author: johntankm

title: amazing experience
text: Myself and my boyfriend really enjoyed the overall experience. Rod was very funny and so knowledgeable, answering all our questions. The half day was well planned and gave us a chance to grab food and an amazing coffee before sagrada de familia. Would recommend the experience if new to barcelona and trying to understand its history!
